Label: Hypersensitive Narcissism Scale
Description: Hypersensitive Narcissism Scale. Measures vulnerable narcissism. 10 items. Reference: Hendin, H. M., & Cheek, J. M. (1997). Assessing hypersensitive narcissism: A reexamination of Murray's Narcism Scale. Journal of Research in Personality, 31(4), 588-599.
